title: Facilitating Trustworthy Human-Agent Collaboration in LLM-based Multi-Agent System oriented Software Engineering
reasoning: The paper proposes a framework (RACI-based) for assigning responsibilities in human-agent collaborative software engineering. Although it references ethical guidelines and 'Trustworthy AI' principles (such as accountability and transparency) as requirements for the system, it does not evaluate or benchmark morals, ethics, or religion itself.
